stations.title: Wilma
stations.say: It's July! Put them on the site.

stations.title: Branches
stations.text: The sale and the July book wait apart.

captions: It is July, and Wilma wants the sale and the reading group's book on the site.
Both wait on branches of their own, and main does not have them.
You merge two branches into main and tidy up, in three tasks.
The sale and the July book are on main, and the window display still waits.
Branches came back together, and the graph shows how.
